mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Clear skies and a comfortable 78 degrees are making for a beautiful afternoon at Harriet Park. Later tonight, expect a waning crescent moon and a visible pass of the Space Station starting at 9:05 PM, passing halfway up the sky from the southwest over Mount Horeb toward the northeast over Fitchburg and Madison.

In local news, the Verona Area School District recently shared information with police regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student from 2019. Following an investigation, thirty-four-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison was booked into the Dane County Jail on one count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.

For upcoming events, look for yoga happening today at Insight Wellness Verona. Tomorrow brings trivia options with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. On Wednesday, you can head downtown for the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.
In the weekly police report, a Madison resident was arrested last Friday following an investigation into a school staff member relationship that occurred in 2019.
To wrap up your day, Culver's is currently open and serving Georgia Peach as today's flavor of the day. You have until 10:00 PM tonight to stop by and get a scoop.
